pages.text: Love and Loathe adds an AI tool that lets a maid lie down and roll, or stand back up. It is available while “More AI functions” is enabled.$(br2)The “#全体 装死” broadcast can also make every maid owned by the player feign death at once.
Its saddle launch is integrated with ragdolls: a launched maid flies out as a ragdoll. With the ragdoll launch option and the matching sound option enabled, the launch also plays a special sound.
